facts.fact: In 2025, out-of-home (OOH) ad spending surpassed $9 billion USD, according to eMarketer as cited by the page.
facts.quote: In 2025, [out-of-home](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/out-of-home-advertising) (OOH) ad spending surpassed [$9 billion USD]

facts.fact: DOOH makes up roughly 34% of total OOH investment, according to a The Drum article cited by the page.
facts.quote: with DOOH making up roughly [34% of total OOH investment]

facts.fact: Direct insertion orders (IOs) often require higher minimum spends, so they are best suited for larger campaigns planned in advance rather than quick activations.
facts.quote: direct IOs often require higher minimum spends, so they’re best suited for larger campaigns planned in advance rather than quick activations.

facts.fact: Programmatic guaranteed or direct IOs offer more certainty for securing premium DOOH screens during major events such as the Olympics, World Cup, or key industry conferences.
facts.quote: If you need to secure premium screens during major events like the Olympics, World Cup, or key industry conferences, [programmatic guaranteed](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/programmatic-guaranteed) or direct IOs offer more certainty.

facts.fact: Adding too many layers of targeting can narrow reach and limit delivery frequency, especially if bids are on the lower end, according to StackAdapt.
facts.quote: adding too many layers of targeting can narrow your reach and limit delivery frequency, especially if your bids are on the lower end.

facts.fact: Open exchanges or private marketplace deals (PMPs) are often the best bet for flexibility, room to test creatives, or stretching a smaller budget in DOOH buying.
facts.quote: If you want flexibility, room to test creatives, or to stretch a smaller budget, open exchanges or PMPs are often your best bet.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Creative Studio advises avoiding white backgrounds for DOOH ads because white on LED screens lacks the pop or vibrancy of other colours, and recommends darker backgrounds instead.
facts.quote: In LED technology, white doesn’t carry the same pop or vibrancy as other colours. Use darker backgrounds to make your messaging, products, and visuals stand out.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Creative Studio says rich, bold background colours perform better during the day, while pastel colours stand out more at night.
facts.quote: Rich, bold background colours, like the ones in this ad for a ramen restaurant, perform better during the day, while pastel colours stand out more at night.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Creative Studio recommends oversized, easy-to-read text for large-format DOOH ads.
facts.quote: For large-format DOOH ads, use oversized text that’s clear and easy to read from a distance.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that viewers have only a few seconds to take in a DOOH message, so creative should use a single clear focal point.
facts.quote: Viewers have only a few seconds to take in your message, so choose images with a single, clear focal point that draws attention instantly.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says environments with longer dwell times, such as elevators, airport terminals, or waiting rooms, allow room for more detail or storytelling in DOOH creative.
facts.quote: Environments with longer dwell times—like elevators, airport terminals, or waiting rooms—give you room for a bit more detail or storytelling.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that too much text or too many elements dilute DOOH ad impact, especially when ads are viewed from a distance.
facts.quote: Keep designs clean and focused. Too much text or too many elements dilute impact, especially when ads are viewed from a distance.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes AWS re:Invent, CES, and Dreamforce as tentpole events that draw industry leaders and senior executives, and as prime DOOH opportunities for B2B marketers.
facts.quote: Think of tentpole events like AWS re:Invent, CES, and Dreamforce—large-scale conferences that draw industry leaders and senior executives from around the world.

facts.fact: StackAdapt and MOBSTA's holiday DOOH campaign for Michael Kors Jewelry delivered more than 14 million impressions, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: The campaign delivered more than 14 million impressions by running in airports, luxury malls, and high streets

facts.fact: According to OAAA data cited by StackAdapt, nearly 60% of US adults recall seeing an OOH ad for a major sporting event.
facts.quote: recall seeing an OOH ad for a major sporting event, and 90% take an action after seeing one

facts.fact: According to an eMarketer forecast cited by StackAdapt, in-store retail media is projected to account for 55.9% of total DOOH growth between 2025 and 2029.
facts.quote: account for 55.9% of total DOOH growth between 2025 and 2029

facts.fact: Because of industry regulations, promotion of prescription products is limited in healthcare DOOH campaigns, so DOOH mainly serves adjacent categories such as wellness services, medical tech, and consumer health products.
facts.quote: Because of industry regulations, promotion of prescription products is limited.
